name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.11964. Gaia2 is built on the ARE asynchronous environment framework and a Mobile environment with 12 apps and 101 tools. Mobile universes are synthetic but coherent user-centered app states seeded from personas and propagated across apps for consistency, with hundreds of thousands of tokens of structured and unstructured content. Annotators use the ARE interface to create scenario DAGs of write actions and environment events, each designed to isolate capabilities such as execution, search, ambiguity, adaptability, and time. Scenarios undergo multiple rounds of independent validation, automated graph guardrails, and baseline-agent difficulty calibration. The five core splits contain 800 unique human-authored scenarios; Gaia2-mini and Noise/Agent2Agent augmentations bring the benchmark to 1,120 scenarios. Evaluation runs agents with a ReAct-style scaffold in asynchronous time and uses an ARE write-action verifier for pass@1 and related scores.
